_readme: This file is TRACKED and PUBLIC (larrymandras/codepulse). Sensitive/ambiguous root names belong in config/workspace.local.json, which is gitignored (D-17). The allowlist below is deny-by-default (D-02): any file whose basename/extension is not explicitly matched is withheld from the snapshot, never shared.

shareableAllowlist._excludedFromAllowlistRationale: The extensions deliberately absent from `default.extensions` below are NOT an omission to fill: .json .yml .yaml .toml .ini .cfg .conf .env .envfile .pem .key .crt .cer .p12 .pfx .ppk .sh .bash .zsh .ps1 .psm1 .bat .cmd .vbs .sql .db .sqlite .sqlite3 .log .csv .tsv .bak .keychain .kdbx, plus any extensionless file. The classification decides whether a FILENAME is transmitted, and a config/script/credential filename is itself a disclosure — generate_admin_key.sh and selfhosted.envfile are the two measured proofs (D-02, D-17). Do not add any of these back.
shareableAllowlist._byRootSemantics: When byRoot[id] is present for a root, it REPLACES `default` for that root entirely — it does not merge with `default`.

_rootExclusionRationale: Roots removed 2026-08-12 at the D-12 review, because the first REAL scan measured 15,648 directories and the ingest mutation chunk-inserts under a ~16,000-doc per-invocation write ceiling that it SHARES with its own inline prune (convex/workspaceHttp.ts:44-47, convex/workspace.ts:51-57). Inserts alone were 98% of that ceiling, so the first pruning ingest would have exceeded it at any WORKSPACE_DELETE_CAP value - raising the cap makes it worse, not better. Removed here: `claude` (C:/Users/mandr/.claude, 3,458 dirs) and `claude-alt` (C:/Users/mandr/.claude-alt, 1,077 dirs) - agent config trees, near-zero workspace-map value per directory. Removed in config/workspace.local.json for the same reason: `pgsql-16` (3,089 dirs, a vendored Postgres install) and the ten astridr-*-wt / astridr-wt-* worktrees (3,112 dirs), which are near-identical copies of the separately-scanned `astridr-repo`. Net effect 15,648 -> ~4,900 dirs. NOTE: mergeWorkspaceConfig has no root-REMOVAL mechanism (local wins on id collision and appends new ids, hooks/workspaceConfig.mjs:68-71), so a root can only be dropped by deleting it from the file that declares it - that is why this edit spans both the tracked and local configs.

roots.evidence: D-15: demonstrably contains Work, Consulting and Personal material mixed together; any single root-level department label would be an assertion the scanner inferred rather than knew.
CodePulse is the telemetry dashboard for Astridr, which Larry's global CLAUDE.md lists under Personal as 'Astridr (personal AI assistant framework)'.
